name: Moonlight Lovers
source: Each story is divided into chapters. In each episode, you will have to make many choices to personalize your interactive story. You can play for free and in any order all the choice games of the Moonlight Lovers series. Each character has his own love story, his own adventure and his own mysteries ... Your romance can end in three different ways in these choice games: it's up to you to unravel all the mysteries of the manor and the vampires who reside there!
translation: 每个故事都分为章节。在每一集中，你都必须做出许多选择来个性化你的互动故事。你可以免费并以任何顺序玩《月光恋人》系列的所有精选游戏。每个角色都有自己的爱情故事、自己的冒险和自己的秘密……在这些选择游戏中，你的浪漫可以以三种不同的方式结束：由你来解开庄园和居住在那里的吸血鬼的所有秘密！
